description: A recording's numbers, read by the page alone. kind: a bed (a loop under the physics), a shot (played once) or the probe (decoded to choose the format). voice: which of the page's voices plays it (none where empty). gain: dB over that voice's own level. note: a shot's own pitch, Hz, where it is played at other pitches (one fog signal's recording at each device's note). loop: the stretch of a shot, s, looped to sound as long as it is meant to (a fog signal's blast). The rest is written by go run ./tools/sounds -encode: the SHA-256 of the master it was built from, its seconds and channels, the WebM's integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP), and each file's bytes.
